project.name: AGILLM
project.purpose: Develop and test capital-efficient transformer training, multi-mode generation objectives, and a detachable small student.
project.claim_policy: Measured, configured, experimental, and planned facts are labelled separately.
project.research_thesis: Transformer neural networks are treated by the project as a general-intelligence substrate; AGILLM focuses on making that substrate more efficient, flexible, auditable, and deployable.

live_training_snapshot.latest_loss_caveat: A single training-loss sample is noisy and is not a capability score.

diffusion_blocks.full_stack_anchor: A small full-stack anchor pass accompanies the local block update in the current run.
diffusion_blocks.claim_limit: The design reduces the main local-update footprint. End-to-end efficiency versus a controlled dense baseline still needs an ablation.

generation_objectives.status: co-trained objectives; complete public inference support is still experimental
generation_objectives.sat: Semi-autoregressive: trains grouped-token generation, including fixed and variable forms in the experimental student path.

detachable_student.label: 49.1M pocket model
detachable_student.training_method: teacher-output knowledge distillation during the parent training programme
detachable_student.important_wording: It is detachable and Matryoshka-inspired, but the live contract reports that it is not a literal strict parameter subset of the parent.
detachable_student.export_status_caveat: The serving team is actively upgrading the standalone export; check the current runtime before describing available modes.

validation.status: measured fixed held-out cross-entropy training signal
validation.interpretation: Lower held-out cross-entropy shows improved performance on the fixed evaluation block; broader capability, reasoning, and safety are evaluated with separate suites.

data.caveat: A source count is not a data-quality or licensing audit. Full dataset documentation remains a required milestone.

hardware_and_cost.status: measured rental listing at snapshot time
hardware_and_cost.cost_caveat: This is the current GPU rental price only. It excludes prior experiments, storage, bandwidth, hosting, labour, and future evaluation costs.

claim_ledger.claim: The checkpoint was actively training on one RTX 3090 at the snapshot time.
The main local update selected 2 of 28 transformer layers, or 7.14% of trainable block parameters.
Fixed-block held-out cross-entropy improved from 10.3092 to 9.1006.
The live trainer co-trains AR, SAT, and NAT objectives.
The approach may lower the cost of serious independent model research.

known_limitations: Publish a standardized capability evaluation suite for the live checkpoint.
Complete a controlled dense-baseline ablation for end-to-end DiffusionBlocks efficiency.
Verify every intended standalone mode in the 49.1M export runtime.
Complete independent reproduction of the training and evaluation path.
Complete safety, bias, memorization, data-rights, and deployment-risk evaluations.
next_milestones: Run and publish standardized capability, efficiency, safety, and memorization evaluations.
Complete controlled ablations for block-wise training and multi-objective decoding.
Stabilize and verify the detachable student's standalone multi-mode inference.
Publish a reproducible technical report, model card, data statement, and independent-review package.
